item.title: [7] Reconfigurable mmWave microchips co-integrating hBN switches on GaN
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Dimitra Psychogiou, Mario Lanza

Authors: Sebastian Pazos, Andrés Fontana, Yaqing Shen, et al.

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Applied condensed matter research on 2D hBN and GaN for mmWave circuits, relevant to 2D materials.

Tags: #2Dmaterials #hBN #GaN #devicephysics #mmWave

Abstract: Radio-frequency switches made from two-dimensional layered hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) were co-integrated on gallium nitride (GaN) microchips to build programmable millimetre-wave (mmWave) monolithic microwave integrated circuits suitable for 6G hardware.
